answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 48 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in grove, verified in echo, and zephyr names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Ten thousand fake identities would need 48 days and roughly 1 million dollars to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
